in_scope.instructions:
[Non-Core]
.mongodb.com/ is in scope, and includes
mongodb.com/docs/
support.mongodb.com
All others sites that follow that pattern are in-scope. If the site is owned by MongoDB, it is eligible for a bounty. If it’s owned by a 3rd party, it is not eligible for a bounty. This scope is a catch-all for all products not listed individually with the 'Atlas' Prefix, or covered as an Atlas product, listed elsewhere in the scope.
mongodb.com/community/forums is in scope, but not eligible for a bounty.
feedback.mongodb.com is out of scope and not eligible for bounty. Please do not test that platform. All bugs should be reported to AHA, not MongoDB.
Artifactory is being deprecated and not eligible for bounty.
